user_request: Too light - can we go half-way between the two?

target.method: Arithmetic midpoint of matching unobstructed side-border median RGB samples in 14 and 15; approximate digital target, not a press specification.

generation_input.prompt: Edit this cover's yellow page surround to a shade HALFWAY BETWEEN the two reference images. Reference 1 is revision 14, the deeper yellow; reference 2 is revision 15, the lighter yellow that the user found TOO LIGHT. Split the difference: medium sunny yellow, midway in lightness/saturation between these exact versions. Border samples give RGB 240,201,69 for reference 1 and RGB 253,222,115 for reference 2. Aim for the intermediate RGB 246,212,92 / #F6D45C, not either endpoint. Change ONLY the exposed page surround outside the photograph. Maintain the same subtle matte surface; no strong gradient or vignette. Keep the photograph’s own colour, exposure, face, hands, plants and detail unchanged; do not retouch, stylise or redraw the photographic subjects. Preserve the exact complete cover composition and proportions from reference 1: centred rectangular photo of John tending a tomato plant; WHITE Lilita One title 'The Vegetable Guru', including 'The'; WHITE subtitle circle partly overlapping the lower-left photo edge; DARK GREEN 'Your at-a-glance growing companion' in the circle; DARK GREEN 'John Lennon' bottom right. All shapes, fonts, spacing, letter sizes, line breaks, overlap positions and margins unchanged. White must stay white, not creamy/yellow, and dark green must stay dark green. Return ONE full flat front-cover image in the same 1100 x 1430 portrait proportions, no mockup or comparison sheet.
